name: Preuve AI: Startup Idea Validation
description:
Market research and competitive intelligence for founders, and the white-label engine agencies, accelerators and consultants use to pre-qualify inbound startups. Preuve AI runs an idea through 60+ live sources (Crunchbase, Product Hunt, Reddit, news) to map demand, competitors, sentiment and risks, every finding linked to a source you can verify. Real signals, not a confident AI score with nothing behind it.

Ask Claude to validate an idea and get back:
- A scored verdict (0-100) with the main blockers
- Competitors mapped with funding, pricing and positioning
- Market size (TAM/SAM/SOM) backed by sources
- Quotes from real people who already have this pain, from Reddit and niche forums
- Pivot recommendations specific to your market

Run one idea, or screen a batch of up to 10 and compare scores before committing to one.

Safe by default: read tools are read-only, and analyses default to free starter scans. Claude never spends paid quota unless you explicitly ask for a deep report.

7,000+ ideas scanned to date.

Requires a Preuve AI account with paid access (Founder Report or higher).

_published_faq.name: How do I add Preuve AI: Startup Idea Validation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Preuve AI: Startup Idea Validation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.preuve.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Preuve AI: Startup Idea Validation MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preuve AI: Startup Idea Validation provides these MCP tools: create_batch, enrich_analysis, export_analysis, export_batch, get_analysis, get_batch, and start_analysis.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Preuve AI: Startup Idea Validation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Preuve AI: Startup Idea Validation in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Preuve AI: Startup Idea Validation MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preuve AI: Startup Idea Validation requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Preuve AI: Startup Idea Validation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preuve AI: Startup Idea Validation is developed by Preuve AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
